host.title: Hosting
host.signedOutBody: Sign in to open seats at your table or sell food you made. Guests pay a small deposit in the app and the rest to you in person.
host.earningsHelp: What you've collected and what's coming
host.noUpcoming: No upcoming guests yet. They'll show here as soon as someone books.
host.noTables: No tables yet. Open seats at your home table for a shared meal.
host.noMarket: Nothing for sale yet. Sell cakes, bread, jars or frozen meals for pickup.
host.emptyBody: Cook what you love, set a few seats, and meet people over dinner. Or sell something you made for pickup.
hostNew.discardBody: What you've entered so far will be lost.
hostNew.type.title: What are you sharing?
hostNew.type.body: You can post both kinds, one at a time.
hostNew.type.tableBody: Open seats at your home table for a shared, home-cooked meal.
hostNew.type.marketBody: Cakes, bread, jars, frozen meals: guests order and pick up from you.
hostNew.photos.title: Add photos
hostNew.photos.body: Up to 6 photos. The first one is the cover guests see first.
hostNew.photos.hint: Opens options to make it the cover or remove it
hostNew.photos.help: Tap a photo to make it the cover or remove it. Daylight and a clean plate work best.
hostNew.photos.deniedCamera: Camera access is off for Eatery. You can turn it on in Settings.
hostNew.photos.pickFailed: Couldn't add that photo. Please try another one.
hostNew.basics.title: The food
hostNew.basics.bodyTable: Make it sound like what you'd cook for friends.
hostNew.basics.bodyMarket: Say what it is, how it's made and how it keeps.
hostNew.basics.name: Title

hostNew.basics.writeNeedsTitle: Add a title first. Any notes in the description are used too.
hostNew.basics.writeFailed: Couldn't write a description right now. You can write your own.
hostNew.when.bodyTable: Pick the day, when guests arrive and roughly when it ends.
hostNew.when.bodyMarket: Guests come to pick up during this window.

hostNew.when.booked_other: {{count}} already booked: you can't go below that.
hostNew.when.drinksHelp: Guests like to know what to bring.
hostNew.where.title: Where is it?
hostNew.where.body: Move the map so the pin sits on your place.
hostNew.where.mapLabel: Map. Move it so the pin is on your place.
hostNew.where.mapHelp: Guests see only the area, never the exact spot, until they book.
hostNew.where.locationFailed: Couldn't find your location. Move the map by hand instead.
hostNew.where.areaHelp: The neighbourhood and city guests see on the listing.
hostNew.where.addressHelp: Only shared with guests who book.
hostNew.safety.title: Allergens and diets
hostNew.safety.body: Guests with allergies rely on this. Mark everything your food contains.
hostNew.safety.suggested: We've marked what your description suggests. Suggested — please check.
hostNew.safety.allergensHelp: Include traces and anything in sauces, dressings or bread.
hostNew.safety.dietaryHelp: Only mark a diet if every dish fits it.
hostNew.safety.confirmHelp: You're responsible for what you serve.
hostNew.price.title: Price
hostNew.price.bodyTable: What one guest pays for the meal.
hostNew.price.depositHelp: About 12%, paid in the app when they book. This is Eatery's fee.
hostNew.price.inPersonHelp: The rest, paid to you directly.
hostNew.price.splitNoteTable: Per seat. The exact deposit is shown to the guest before they pay.
hostNew.price.splitNoteMarket: Per item. The exact deposit is shown to the guest before they pay.
hostNew.review.title: Ready to publish?
hostNew.review.body: This is how guests will see your listing.

hostNew.error.photosFailed: A photo didn't upload. Tap it to try again, or remove it.

hostNew.error.past: Choose a time in the future.
hostNew.error.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.

hostManage.notFoundBody: It may have been removed, or it isn't one of yours.
hostManage.addressPrivate: Exact address: only shared with guests who book.
hostManage.noGuests: No guests yet. Share your listing to get the first booking.
hostManage.noOrders: No orders yet. Share your listing to get the first one.
hostManage.collectNote: Guests paid the deposit in the app. Collect the balance from them in person.
hostManage.noShowBody: Only do this if the guest didn't come. It's recorded on their profile.
hostManage.cancelBookingBody: The guest gets their deposit back, and a cancellation is added to your profile.
hostManage.cancelListingHelp: Every guest who booked is refunded.
hostManage.cancelListingBody: It will be taken down and no one else can book it.

hostManage.cancelListingBodyGuests_other: It will be taken down and all {{count}} bookings are cancelled. Every guest gets their deposit back.
hostManage.edit.title: Edit listing
hostManage.edit.fixErrors: Some details need fixing. Check the fields marked in red.
hostManage.edit.priceWarning: Guests who already booked keep the price they paid.
hostManage.edit.cancelledBody: A cancelled listing can't be edited. Create a new one instead.
earnings.title: Earnings
earnings.heading: Your earnings
earnings.explain: Guests pay the balance to you directly, in person. Eatery keeps only the booking deposit they pay in the app.
earnings.emptyBody: Once guests book and you host them, what you collect shows here.
hostNew.quick.title: What's in it?
hostNew.quick.help: Tap what applies — guests filter by this. You can fine-tune it on the safety step.
hostNew.quick.unsureHelp: No problem: we'll suggest allergens from your description, and you check them before publishing.
hostNew.diningPhoto.title: Photo of where you'll eat

hostNew.diningPhoto.help: Required. A quick photo of the table or room; it's saved to your profile for next time.
